names.legendary: Stratos, Sovereign of the Seven Skies

lore.common: Lives for the moment the boarding gate closes. Always eats the last complimentary pretzel.
lore.uncommon: Draws white signatures across the sky. Air traffic control says they all spell "I am bored".
lore.rare: Its cargo belly is a maze of missing suitcases. Some travellers have received luggage from next Thursday.
lore.epic: Raced the jet stream and folded three thunderstorms into paper aeroplanes. Air traffic control requested a quiet weekend.
lore.legendary: Carried the very first sunrise around the world before dawn had a name. Every runway still points toward the place Stratos sleeps.

names.legendary: Kestrelion, Ace of the Forgotten Skies

lore.common: Coughs on takeoff so theatrically that the cows lie down in protest.
lore.uncommon: Insists two pairs of wings are better than one. Has never been able to explain the arithmetic.
lore.rare: Can slip between two haystacks and steal the scarecrow's hat without disturbing a single straw.
lore.epic: Looped around the county fair so boldly that every ice cream cone pointed skyward. The pilots blamed atmospheric enthusiasm.
lore.legendary: The last ace of an age of canvas wings and impossible courage. Kestrelion can still fly beneath a rainbow and emerge a century earlier.

names.legendary: Zephyria, Lady of the Last Updraft

lore.common: Waits patiently for a tow into the sky, then tells the powered aircraft it prefers travelling without engine noise.
lore.uncommon: Goes flying with the birds but refuses to share their worms.
lore.rare: Finds warm columns of rising air as easily as a dog finds dropped sausages.
lore.epic: Silently looped over the town's parade and stole the attention from every marching band.
lore.legendary: Zephyria once glided for seven summers without landing, carried by winds nobody else could feel. On the final day, she touched down only to return a lost feather.

names.legendary: Major Whoosh, Defender of the Duvet

lore.common: Zooms over the sofa making engine noises louder than the vacuum cleaner.
lore.uncommon: Claims the cushion fort is enemy territory and refuses to land until dinner.
lore.rare: Fires one tiny plastic missile into the biscuit tin and declares a flawless mission.
lore.epic: Led every model plane into a midnight dogfight over the sleeping household. The curtains surrendered, but the teddy bears held their position.
lore.legendary: Major Whoosh flew a thousand imaginary missions without losing a wing. When the child who owned it grew up, the toy guarded their old bedroom and waited for the next adventure.

names.legendary: Skymarina, Navigator of the Secret Lakes

lore.common: Lands beside the ducks without warning and gets thoroughly scolded by the entire flock.
lore.uncommon: Wobbles on its floats like a very tall bird trying to remember how to swim.
lore.rare: Delivers letters to distant lakes with no roads and leaves tiny wake-shaped signatures on the water.
lore.epic: Landed on the lake during a royal regatta and splashed every racing yacht clean. The sailors filed a complaint and a thank-you note.
lore.legendary: Skymarina once found a lake hidden above the clouds and landed upon its silver water. Each year she returns with a bottle of rain for the valleys below.

names.legendary: Commander Pips, First Bear on Mars

lore.common: Counts backward from ten every time it's touched, then launches itself an inch and requests applause.
lore.uncommon: Its plastic fins wobble whenever the cat approaches mission control.
lore.rare: Rockets from the lower bunk to the top without waking the teddy bear acting as navigator.
lore.epic: Launched the entire toy cupboard into orbit around the ceiling fan. The model planets filed a noise complaint.
lore.legendary: Commander Pips reached Mars with only a bicycle pump, two stickers and a teddy-bear crew. The Martians have preserved his tiny cardboard flag in a museum.

names.legendary: Aesculon, Herald of the Last Siren

lore.common: Practises its siren in the driveway at 3 a.m. Claims this is important medical training.
lore.uncommon: Has a flashing blue crest and a suspicious fondness for shortcuts. Its patients arrive before they call.
lore.rare: Senses a stubbed toe from three streets away. Unfortunately, it brings an entire operating theatre for every splinter.
lore.epic: Parted a city's gridlocked traffic like a zipper, then reversed all the way back to rescue a kitten. The traffic has remained politely separated.
lore.legendary: Aesculon can hear a heartbeat beneath an avalanche and race between two seconds to reach it. Even Death has learned to pull over when its siren sounds.

names.legendary: Zephyrina, Queen of the Wandering Skies

lore.common: Roars its burner just as the quiet countryside is falling asleep.
lore.uncommon: Drifts away whenever the pilot says, 'We'll be right back.' The pilot no longer makes promises.
lore.rare: Lands in a sheep field and convinces the flock the enormous colourful envelope is a new shepherd.
lore.epic: Launched a thousand balloons at sunrise, painting the entire horizon like a floating quilt. The city cancelled work to watch it drift past.
lore.legendary: Zephyrina travels on winds no compass can name. Once each century she lowers her wicker basket to the highest peak and offers a lost climber a ride home.

names.legendary: Bitumax, Architect of the Black Horizon

lore.common: Leaves warm, sticky footprints on freshly paved streets. Traffic cones follow it like ducklings.
lore.uncommon: Belches clouds of hot tarmac scent. Cats adore the heated roads it makes; cyclists are less enthusiastic.
lore.rare: Can seal any pothole with one heavy step. The town council has tried to hire it, but it demands payment in traffic cones.
lore.epic: Rolled through a ruined city overnight, laying flawless black roads over every crater. By morning the roads had arranged themselves into a gigantic racetrack.
lore.legendary: Bitumax once paved a highway across a sea of molten stone so refugees could escape a volcano. That road still hums beneath travellers' wheels, even centuries later.

names.legendary: Dozeroth, Mover of Mountains

lore.common: Pushes the same dirt pile backwards and forwards for hours. Calls it landscaping.
lore.uncommon: Lowers its enormous blade whenever annoyed. Nobody can tell if it is smiling.
lore.rare: Ploughed through a construction site and accidentally delivered the foreman's lunch three streets away.
lore.epic: Shoved an entire hill into a new location before breakfast. The mapmakers have asked it to stop rearranging their work.
lore.legendary: Dozeroth sleeps beneath the oldest mountain range. When it stirs, valleys shift and rivers change course; once it merely wanted a wider parking space.

names.legendary: Gravadra, Sculptor of Mountains

lore.common: Smooths a muddy road beautifully, then leaves one bump exactly where the bus driver sits.
lore.uncommon: Wears its great steel blade across its belly like a knight who forgot which way to hold a sword.
lore.rare: Cuts perfect drainage channels that lead every puddle directly to the mayor's driveway.
lore.epic: Shaved every road in the kingdom perfectly flat. The king's carriage rolled downhill into the sea without encountering a single bump.
lore.legendary: The oldest mountain road was carved by Gravadra in one stroke of a silver blade. Each winter it returns to trim the mountain when it grows too proud.

names.legendary: Compactor, Maker of the King's Highway

lore.common: Rolls so slowly that pigeons stop to ask if it needs a push.
lore.uncommon: Compresses a puddle into a perfect pancake-shaped splash.
lore.rare: Levels a broken street with one pass, leaving the cobblestones as smooth as polished glass.
lore.epic: Flattened every bump in the royal road overnight. The king enjoyed his smooth ride until the hills demanded their curves back.
lore.legendary: Compactor paved a road across the impossible mountain pass to reunite two villages after a hundred winters. Its iron drum still echoes beneath the stones.

names.legendary: Skidzilla, the Tiny Titan of the Yard

lore.common: Turns on the spot and scoops the gardener's wheelbarrow instead of the dirt.
lore.uncommon: Swaps its bucket for a brush so often that the foreman begins checking its mood.
lore.rare: Fits through a narrow gate and rearranges an entire construction site before the big machines arrive.
lore.epic: Dug a maze of perfect trenches across the fairground in one afternoon. The children promptly declared it a new attraction.
lore.legendary: Skidzilla moved a mountain of rubble one little bucket at a time to uncover a buried bell tower. The great bell rang when daylight finally touched it, and every excavator bowed.

names.legendary: Rollomund, Who Pressed the Mountains

lore.common: Wheezes into life just as the workers have decided to take their tea break.
lore.uncommon: Flattens everything except the one hump in the road it was hired to fix.
lore.rare: Smooths a cobbled lane so perfectly that the bicycles start gliding uphill on their own.
lore.epic: Flattened an entire miniature golf course into one enormous green, leaving the players to argue over whether every hole was now a hole-in-one.
lore.legendary: Rollomund pressed the jagged peaks of an ancient mountain range into a gentle plain. The giants were furious until they discovered how easy it was to play marbles.

names.legendary: Granitusk, the Mountain Mover

lore.common: Drops one perfect pebble out of its bucket whenever a foreman passes.
lore.uncommon: Lifts its loader arms like a champion showing off a trophy.
lore.rare: Scoops an entire hillock of gravel into a truck without spilling the driver's tea.
lore.epic: Rearranged every mound in the quarry overnight, building a stone maze that trapped the manager's car at its centre.
lore.legendary: Carried the fallen stones of a shattered mountain to build a safe road between two isolated towns. Its steel bucket still holds one pebble from every journey.

names.legendary: Omnibus Rex, King of the Final Stop

lore.common: Closes its doors precisely as you reach them. The driver swears he heard it giggle.
lore.uncommon: Kneels at each stop like a courteous elephant, then refuses to rise until somebody thanks it.
lore.rare: Shows a destination that exists only on rainy Thursdays. The passengers return with souvenirs from tomorrow.
lore.epic: Swallowed a motorway traffic jam whole and spat out every car in alphabetical order. The transport minister called it a pilot scheme.
lore.legendary: Carries the souls of every missed connection to a terminus beyond the last timetable. Still insists on exact change and never has a working card reader.

names.legendary: Vroomulus, Emperor of the Endless Lane

lore.common: Honks at its own reflection in shop windows. Insists the other car started it.
lore.uncommon: Circles the car park forever looking for a space that isn't slightly too small.
lore.rare: Drives itself to the petrol station at night and comes back with a receipt you don't remember authorising.
lore.epic: Turned a morning commute into a grand prix around a roundabout. Nobody reached work, but the traffic report won an award.
lore.legendary: Vroomulus has driven every road that exists and several that don't. The speedometer reads INFINITY, yet he still loses ten minutes searching for parking.

names.legendary: Rotavor, the Wheel That Outran Time

lore.common: Finds the only puddle on the road and sends its contents onto somebody's clean trousers.
lore.uncommon: Loses a shiny hubcap in the same hedge every Thursday. The hedge is running out of space.
lore.rare: Can climb off its axle and roll ahead to check traffic. It usually forgets to come back.
lore.epic: Rolled once around the ring road and summoned a cyclone of tyre marks. The roundabout is now technically a racetrack.
lore.legendary: Rotavor has turned since before the first roads were built. One revolution carries it a century forward, so its owner is always behind on servicing.

names.legendary: Saint Calipra of the Final Descent

lore.common: Squeals at red lights just to attract an audience.
lore.uncommon: Gets warm going downhill and demands a cold drink at the bottom.
lore.rare: Can stop a speeding bicycle with a stern look. The rider keeps going for another three metres.
lore.epic: Caught a runaway tram at the edge of the ravine with one glowing rotor. The passengers named every squeaky noise after it.
lore.legendary: Calipra stood alone on the mountain pass when the royal convoy lost its brakes. Her iron embrace halted a hundred carriages, but the horses still tell the story faster.

names.legendary: Petrolia, the Endless Filling Station

lore.common: Drips a little petrol on your shoe after every fill-up.
lore.uncommon: Makes the total jump past a nice round number at the very last second.
lore.rare: Stops filling at precisely the wrong moment, then demands a second visit to complete the job.
lore.epic: Every pump in the city began clicking in unison at midnight. The drivers formed a queue to nowhere and somehow ended up at the beach.
lore.legendary: Petrolia once filled the tanks of every vehicle in a kingdom before sunrise. She refused to fill the king's carriage until he learned to say thank you.

names.legendary: Sir Grinnox, Guardian of the Radiator

lore.common: Smiles through an entire motorway trip with a collection of bugs caught in its teeth.
lore.uncommon: Gleams so fiercely after a wash that passing pigeons stop to fix their feathers in it.
lore.rare: Swallows a cloud of road dust and spits it out in the shape of the car's badge.
lore.epic: Inhaled a travelling carnival's runaway bunting through its slats. The car drove home wearing a festival moustache.
lore.legendary: Sir Grinnox guarded the engine of the oldest racing car. Even after the motor stopped, his great chrome grin drew crowds to the finish line.

names.legendary: Dobbinox, the Never-Empty Wagon

lore.common: Rattles past at walking speed and waves cheerfully at the traffic queue a mile behind.
lore.uncommon: Stacks hay so high the driver needs a periscope to see the road.
lore.rare: Bounces over cobblestones and reorganises every apple crate by launching the apples into the air.
lore.epic: Took a wrong turn on market day and led the entire town's traffic around the duck pond until sunset. The ducks started charging tolls.
lore.legendary: Dobbinox carries the harvest of seven villages in a cart that never fills. The grateful farmers built its horse a stable with a dining room.

names.legendary: Lord Tinford, the Motor Age Awakens

lore.common: Kicks back at anyone who tries to crank it to life before saying good morning.
lore.uncommon: Wears black with such confidence that every newer car looks overdressed.
lore.rare: Rumbled past the stable and convinced the horses a metal animal had stolen their jobs.
lore.epic: Led a procession of ancient motorcars through a modern traffic jam. The satnav announced it had discovered history and promptly fainted.
lore.legendary: Lord Tinford rolled off the very first assembly line and taught a thousand roads to dream of engines. On moonless nights, forgotten highways still hum its starting crank.

names.legendary: Old Oxenford of the Last Road

lore.common: Creaks so loudly that the farmer's cows know dinner is coming an hour early.
lore.uncommon: Moves at the speed of a thoughtful ox and refuses all suggestions to hurry.
lore.rare: Pulls a mountain of vegetables through a flooded field without losing a single turnip.
lore.epic: Carried a village's entire harvest through a mudslide while the newer wagons sank. Arrived just in time for next year's market.
lore.legendary: Old Oxenford hauled the first stones of a forgotten city over mountains where no road existed. Centuries later, the ruts of his wheels still point towards its buried gates.

names.legendary: Guardian Buckle, Promise of Safe Return

lore.common: Locks tight the moment somebody leans forward to adjust the car radio.
lore.uncommon: Twists itself neatly when put on and makes its owner perform an awkward little dance to straighten it.
lore.rare: Holds its passenger firmly when the road suddenly jolts, then releases them with a soft click.
lore.epic: Buckled every rider of a runaway coach into place as it bounced through a mountain pass. The driver called it a miracle; the belt called it Tuesday.
lore.legendary: Guardian Buckle has carried a million silent promises between departure and homecoming. Each safe journey adds one tiny silver click to the song only the road can hear.

names.legendary: Cementor, Architect of Unfinished Ages

lore.common: Spins all day as if worried the concrete will start thinking for itself.
lore.uncommon: Spits a blob of wet cement onto the site foreman's clean boots. It calls it a signature.
lore.rare: Can turn a muddy puddle into a perfect concrete staircase before lunchtime.
lore.epic: Poured an entire new street in one night, complete with traffic lights and a bakery. The houses had not been ordered yet.
lore.legendary: Cementor built the first bridge between two kingdoms that refused to speak. It still stands, though he accidentally included the mayor's car in the foundations.

names.legendary: Aerialis, Reaper of the Highest Stars

lore.common: Lifts its operator to a streetlamp, then develops an interest in the clouds.
lore.uncommon: Reaches across three buildings to retrieve one lost balloon. Demands a hero's medal.
lore.rare: Plucks secrets from rooftop conversations using its extendable arm. The pigeons pay it in crumbs.
lore.epic: Unfolded its hydraulic spine above the capital and changed every streetlight at once. The city accidentally experienced midday at midnight.
lore.legendary: Aerialis stretches its arm into heights no ladder can dream of. Once it reached a fallen star and returned it to the sky with a parking ticket attached.

names.legendary: Lady Skycradle of the Hanging City

lore.common: Dangles its hook outside the office window just long enough to steal the boss's biscuit.
lore.uncommon: Stretches its boom above the buildings and waves at passing clouds. The clouds refuse to wave back.
lore.rare: Lifts a swimming pool onto a skyscraper without spilling a drop. The pigeons have applied for lifeguard jobs.
lore.epic: Lifted the mayor's entire office and placed it on the roof during a budget meeting. The mayor has been taking the stairs ever since.
lore.legendary: Lady Skycradle raised a city of towers on chains above an ancient floodplain. Even now, its people hear her giant hook gently singing whenever the wind changes.

names.legendary: Elevata, the Stairway With No Steps

lore.common: Beeps all the way up and keeps beeping long after it comes back down.
lore.uncommon: Folds like a nervous accordion whenever someone mentions heights.
lore.rare: Raises a painter high enough to reach the ceiling, then nudges the brush toward the tiniest unpainted spot.
lore.epic: Lifted the entire warehouse stock count onto a towering platform. The inventory team discovered a pigeon colony in the rafters.
lore.legendary: Elevata rose from the floor of an ancient quarry until she stood level with the clouds. Travellers climbed her folding tower to read weather warnings written across the sky.

names.legendary: Dumproth, Mover of Mountains

lore.common: Burps gravel on the road whenever it gets excited.
lore.uncommon: Can eat half a quarry before lunch. Never remembers to close its tailgate.
lore.rare: Piles rubble into towers that look suspiciously like its former drivers.
lore.epic: Relocated an entire hillside overnight to make room for a motorway. The construction crew woke up on the wrong side of the valley.
lore.legendary: When two kingdoms fought over a mountain, Dumproth lifted the whole thing and carried it away. Both armies declared victory, then had to learn how to share a flat field.

names.legendary: Backhorath, the Two-Faced Earthshaper

lore.common: Digs a hole with its back arm and fills it with its front bucket. Considers this a productive day.
lore.uncommon: Can wave two buckets at once. Its operators have stopped asking whether it is saying hello or surrendering.
lore.rare: Burrows beneath roads and emerges with relics nobody remembers losing. Last week it found a Roman helmet and a lawn flamingo.
lore.epic: Dug an enormous trench around the city while its front bucket built a defensive wall. The mayor asked for a new roundabout and got a medieval fortress.
lore.legendary: Backhorath wields creation at one end and excavation at the other. It once moved a mountain to make room for a river, then planted a forest where the mountain had stood.

names.legendary: Excavathor, Burier of Forgotten Cities

lore.common: Waves its enormous bucket at the neighbour before digging at seven in the morning.
lore.uncommon: Scratches its own back with the digging arm and removes an entire garden fence.
lore.rare: Can find buried treasure beneath a car park. Unfortunately, it also finds twenty-seven old shopping trolleys.
lore.epic: Dug a shortcut beneath the city and emerged into the mayor's office holding a fossilised dinosaur wearing a traffic cone.
lore.legendary: Excavathor uncovered a city buried long before the first map. It offered to restore the place, but the ancient king demanded a permit in triplicate.

names.legendary: Engine Primus, Guardian of Ash Street

lore.common: Sounds its siren whenever the firefighters try to have lunch.
lore.uncommon: Extends its ladder to wave at people who live on the top floor.
lore.rare: Can thread a hose through a maze of streets without knocking over a single bicycle.
lore.epic: Charged through a gridlocked city to rescue the bakery from a blaze. The firefighters saved the shop; the truck saved the last tray of cinnamon rolls.
lore.legendary: Engine Primus answered the bell through a storm so fierce that even the streetlamps hid. At dawn, every house still stood, and someone had painted THANK YOU on its muddy bonnet.

names.legendary: Rubbish Rosie, Cleaner of Cities

lore.common: Crashes the bins about at six in the morning so nobody can sleep in.
lore.uncommon: Squashes everything in its back with a big grinding crunch.
lore.rare: Swallowed a whole sofa in one go, then asked for more.
lore.epic: Crunched the whole festival's rubbish in one night, including the stage, two tents and the mayor's deckchair.
lore.legendary: Swallowed a wedding ring by mistake, then crunched through a whole mountain of rubbish to give it back before the cake was cut.

names.legendary: Terravolt, Thunderhoof of the Wilds

lore.common: Has four tyres, no patience and a lifelong mission to repaint everyone in mud.
lore.uncommon: Jumps every bump on the trail just to hear its rider squeak. The helmet has filed a complaint.
lore.rare: Climbs cliffs that mountain goats consider unreasonable. Its engine purrs louder the steeper the ground gets.
lore.epic: Tore across the wilderness on four wheels of thunder and turned a dusty canyon into a maze of airborne mud. The local rangers still haven't found the exit.
lore.legendary: Terravolt races the storm across the wildest mountains, leaving molten tyre tracks on bare stone. Some say thunder is merely the sound of its engine starting far away.

names.legendary: Dunefang, King of the Shifting Sands

lore.common: Sprays sand over the one picnic blanket that was still clean. It knows where to aim.
lore.uncommon: Has no doors because it considers climbing a mandatory part of driving.
lore.rare: Leaps over dunes so high that seagulls accuse it of invading their airspace.
lore.epic: Roared across a desert race and left a trail of flying sandcastles. The beach authorities issued it a speeding ticket.
lore.legendary: Dunefang crossed a wasteland with no roads and carved a new horizon with its tyres. The shifting dunes still imitate its tracks every sunset.

names.legendary: Grand Prix Gremlin, Lord of Hairpins

lore.common: Bumps into everyone on the track and says it was the steering.
lore.uncommon: Roars around a corner and immediately blames the tyres when it spins.
lore.rare: Can fit through a gap no sensible driver would attempt. The marshals have stopped guessing.
lore.epic: Spun so fast at the championship that every tyre barrier became a merry-go-round. The spectators bought tickets.
lore.legendary: The Grand Prix Gremlin has raced the same enchanted track for a thousand laps without ageing. Its only rival is a snail that always wins on technicalities.

names.legendary: Quaddragon, Rider of the Broken Tracks

lore.common: Growls through the farmyard and scares the chickens into a perfect line.
lore.uncommon: Takes the scenic route through every puddle and brings most of it home.
lore.rare: Herds runaway sheep over rocky fields with a roar that makes the sheep choose the sensible gate.
lore.epic: Leapt an entire ravine during the mountain race and landed on the finish-line picnic. Nobody complained after seeing the trophy.
lore.legendary: Quaddragon has circled a volcano on four wheels since its first eruption. Every time it jumps the lava river, the locals hold up scorecards.

names.legendary: Terraquadra, Plough of the First Dawn

lore.common: Leaves muddy tracks so wide that the chickens use them as lanes.
lore.uncommon: Pulls a hay wagon while grumbling in four enormous wheels.
lore.rare: Drags a plough across fields too heavy for three ordinary tractors, without spilling the driver's tea.
lore.epic: Tore through a field of frozen earth and uncovered a buried village. The villagers thanked it for finally fixing the road.
lore.legendary: Terraquadra dragged a wandering island back to its harbour so that the farmers could reach their fields. It now demands four parking spaces.

names.legendary: Rotorella, Queen of the High Rescue

lore.common: Turns the laundry line into a flag parade every time it hovers above a garden.
lore.uncommon: Lands on the painted H at the hospital and gets cross when somebody draws a smaller H on a picnic blanket.
lore.rare: Hovers above a mountain ledge so steadily that a stranded goat climbs aboard without spilling its breakfast.
lore.epic: Swept over the city festival and sent every loose hat spinning into the air. The hats returned in perfect alphabetical order.
lore.legendary: Rotorella flew through a blizzard to rescue the village's last sheep. For generations the sheep's descendants have watched the sky for a spinning halo whenever storms gather.

names.legendary: The Needle That Pinned the Wind

lore.common: Clangs its rope against the metal all night to keep the street awake.
lore.uncommon: Raises the flag the wrong way up whenever the mayor visits.
lore.rare: Stays upright in storms while every nearby hat flies away.
lore.epic: Lifted a banner so immense above the market that the whole town spent a week in shade. The stallholders started charging for the excellent weather.
lore.legendary: Legend says the Needle pinned the first fierce wind to the heavens so sailors could find their way home. Its rope still sings whenever a storm remembers that day.

names.legendary: Reaporius, the Golden Horizon

lore.common: Blocks a narrow country lane while moving exactly slower than a person walking a dog.
lore.uncommon: Blows a cloud of chaff across the field, giving every scarecrow a new hairstyle.
lore.rare: Swallows an entire row of wheat and leaves the straw neatly stacked for astonished mice.
lore.epic: Harvested the valley overnight while the farmers slept. By dawn the fields had become a golden maze visible from the clouds.
lore.legendary: Reaporius follows the first autumn moon across the ancient grainlands. Each field it crosses yields enough bread to feed the travellers who sheltered there in winter.

names.legendary: Baleheart, the Harvest Pillow

lore.common: Gets into socks, sandwiches and everyone's sleeves, even when nobody has been near the barn.
lore.uncommon: Rolls downhill in a neat golden cylinder, flattening every picnic blanket in its path.
lore.rare: Builds itself into a perfect hay bale overnight, then moves two feet closer to the farmhouse each morning.
lore.epic: A mountain of stacked bales toppled across the county fair. The villagers spent the week living in a very comfortable golden maze.
lore.legendary: Baleheart sheltered a lost flock through the longest winter in the valley. Come spring, the straw was still warm, and every lamb smelled faintly of sunshine.

names.legendary: Ferrodor, Shield of the Buried City

lore.common: Clanks every time a bus drives over it, keeping perfect time with the timetable.
lore.uncommon: Lets out mysterious warm breaths on cold mornings, startling the early commuters.
lore.rare: Spins in place when the underground trains pass, then settles before anyone looks.
lore.epic: Launched itself into the air during the street festival and revealed a fountain of lost tennis balls beneath the cobbles.
lore.legendary: Ferrodor sealed the gates of a city buried beneath the modern streets. It lifts only for those who remember the forgotten city's name.

names.legendary: Rambla, the House That Followed the Sun

lore.common: Rattles every cup in its cupboards as though breakfast is taking place on a trampoline.
lore.uncommon: Closes its tiny curtains every time another caravan passes. It calls this mysterious behaviour.
lore.rare: Hits one bump and moves the breakfast cereal into the shower. The shampoo is now suspiciously crunchy.
lore.epic: Parked across the campsite entrance and invited everyone inside. The traffic jam became the finest holiday party of the season.
lore.legendary: Rambla roamed the continents so long that every road remembered its tyre tracks. One winter the roads curled back to its door so lost travellers could find their way home.

names.legendary: Grand Plinthorius of the Fallen Heroes

lore.common: Trips every museum visitor who gets too close to the exhibit.
lore.uncommon: Holds a magnificent statue all day while tourists photograph everything except it.
lore.rare: Remembers the name of every hero who has ever stood upon it.
lore.epic: Stood empty at the grand opening and convinced the entire art world that absence was the finest sculpture of the century. The statue asked for a refund.
lore.legendary: Grand Plinthorius carried the memory of heroes after their statues were destroyed. When the city needed courage, their shadows stood upon him again and reminded its people what bravery looked like.

names.legendary: Poleward, Last Standard of the Lost Road

lore.common: Stands exactly where somebody is walking while looking at their phone.
lore.uncommon: Tilts a tiny bit more every time someone leans on it to tie a shoe.
lore.rare: Holds a thousand festival lights without bending. The moths have started calling it their palace.
lore.epic: Braced the town's main street against a wind that tore rooftops away. By sunrise its lights were still glowing above the wreckage.
lore.legendary: Poleward marked the old road through a wilderness after every milestone was lost. Its iron spine endured for centuries, keeping the travellers' lanterns raised above the snow.

names.legendary: Aegiron, the Shield That Refused to Fall

lore.common: Blocks the first wooden sword perfectly, then drops itself on the knight's toe.
lore.uncommon: Collects battle dents like medals and tells a different story about each one.
lore.rare: Catches a whole flight of arrows and arranges them into a bouquet for the archer.
lore.epic: Held the castle gate against a siege so effectively that the attackers asked to borrow it for their own walls.
lore.legendary: Aegiron stood alone between a village and a descending mountain of stone. The landslide split against his battered rim, leaving two hills and one very surprised goat.

names.legendary: Cereswheel, the Harvest's Heart

lore.common: Fills the barn with enough chaff to give the scarecrow a sneezing fit.
lore.uncommon: Rattles all afternoon, then complains it has only been fed half the field.
lore.rare: Separates a cart of wheat in minutes, leaving golden grain stacked as neatly as coins.
lore.epic: Spun a mountain of straw into a whirling fortress during harvest, giving the farm animals a temporary castle.
lore.legendary: Cereswheel worked the last field of a starving kingdom and found enough grain beneath the chaff to feed every family through spring. Farmers still leave one sheaf at its gate.

names.legendary: Turnstorius, the Gate Between Journeys

lore.common: Stops turning the instant someone's bag catches between its bars.
lore.uncommon: Eats a ticket, burps and returns it folded into a tiny bird.
lore.rare: Lets one lost traveller through to a platform nobody else can see.
lore.epic: Spun so rapidly during the morning rush that every commuter reached the right destination but in an entirely different outfit.
lore.legendary: Turnstorius guards a forgotten station between every place a traveller has loved. One turn of his iron arms can open a road to an old memory, but the return journey requires a valid ticket.

names.legendary: Sprinkla, Queen of the Last Sunny Day

lore.common: Plays its tune the moment dinner reaches the table. Parents have filed complaints.
lore.uncommon: Hands over cones so quickly that the sprinkles arrive five seconds after the ice cream.
lore.rare: Can summon an entire street of children with three notes, including the ones hiding in the bath.
lore.epic: Parked at the beach on the first hot day and drew a queue that wrapped around the pier three times. The seagulls started selling tickets.
lore.legendary: Sprinkla's enchanted jingle announces the final golden day of every summer. No child who hears it ever forgets the taste of that last seaside cone.

names.legendary: Commander Rugged, Lord of the Lost Road

lore.common: Seeks out every muddy puddle on the school run, then pretends it wasn't deliberate.
lore.uncommon: Wears a spare tyre on its back like an enormous tortoise shell.
lore.rare: Climbs a rock-strewn hillside that the map insists has no road at all.
lore.epic: Led a safari convoy across a flooded plain and arrived wearing half the river in its radiator grille. The giraffes applauded from dry land.
lore.legendary: Commander Rugged drove across the wildest jungle to find an abandoned trading route. The road has grown over again, but its tyre tracks still guide lost explorers by moonlight.

names.legendary: Escalord of the Infinite Stair

lore.common: Stops moving the instant someone says escalators are better than stairs.
lore.uncommon: Its handrail travels faster than its steps. Every passenger arrives with one stretched arm.
lore.rare: Steals a shoelace at the landing and stores it in a secret drawer full of left shoes.
lore.epic: Ran backwards during a shopping sale and trapped an army of bargain hunters on a staircase that refused to end. They formed a government halfway up.
lore.legendary: An endless stairway winds through Escalord's dreams, passing shops that sold out centuries ago. The last step leads to the food court, which remains mysteriously closed.

names.legendary: Lady Vroomara, Duchess of the Long Road

lore.common: Clears its throat at the traffic lights loudly enough to scare every pigeon on the block.
lore.uncommon: Lifts its front wheel to wave hello. The riding instructor calls this deeply inappropriate.
lore.rare: Slips through impossible gaps in traffic and leaves the cars arguing about whether it was ever there.
lore.epic: Led a procession of roaring bikes over a mountain pass. The thunderclouds joined in and were disqualified for cutting corners.
lore.legendary: Vroomara crossed the desert highway before the first road was laid. Even now the wind carries her engine note across the empty flats when a traveller needs courage.

names.legendary: Sidonius, the Unblinking Passenger

lore.common: Bounces so cheerfully over potholes that the motorcyclist thinks the passenger is applauding.
lore.uncommon: Demands a scarf and goggles even for a short trip to the petrol station.
lore.rare: Lifts its outer wheel on tight turns and politely waves at the stunned traffic.
lore.epic: Carried a whole brass band through the countryside, one musician at a time. Their tubist arrived with an entirely new hairstyle.
lore.legendary: Sidonius carried a lighthouse keeper along the coast when the roads were flooded. His tiny third wheel still glows every foggy night, pointing travellers toward home.

names.legendary: Old Ironjack, Hauler of Impossible Loads

lore.common: Has three mysterious bolts rattling in its bed. The mechanic insists none belong to it.
lore.uncommon: Drops its tailgate at picnics and claims to have invented outdoor furniture.
lore.rare: Carried an entire barn's worth of tools through a flood without losing so much as a rusty nail.
lore.epic: Pulled a hundred stuck vehicles from the festival mud. The drivers formed a grateful queue and immediately got stuck again.
lore.legendary: Old Ironjack hauled a disassembled village across the desert when its river ran dry. Every house arrived intact, and the church bell rang from the truck bed all the way.

names.legendary: Sergeant Bluebolt of the Last Safe Road

lore.common: Turns its siren on briefly at traffic lights and looks very important about it.
lore.uncommon: Flashes its lights to escort lost ducklings across the street.
lore.rare: Finds missing people by following the faintest tyre mark, even through a rainstorm.
lore.epic: Chased a runaway carnival float through every street in town, collecting an entire parade of baffled traffic cones.
lore.legendary: Sergeant Bluebolt guided a thousand refugees through a mountain storm with a single pair of blue lights. The convoy followed the flashes until the first lights of home appeared below.

names.legendary: Mini-Orbita, Messenger of the Desk Stars

lore.common: Points its tiny antenna at the lampshade and waits for a signal from space.
lore.uncommon: Loses a solar panel whenever somebody dusts the science display, then claims it was a meteor strike.
lore.rare: Captures mysterious beeps from the real satellites overhead and translates them into homework excuses.
lore.epic: Activated every classroom model at the science fair, and they began circling the ceiling like a miniature solar system. The headteacher had to dodge Jupiter.
lore.legendary: Mini-Orbita once received an answer from a star a million years away. The message read NICE MODEL, and the school has displayed it in a glass case ever since.

names.legendary: Nomador, Cathedral of the Endless Road

lore.common: Travels at exactly the speed needed to collect forty cars behind it. It calls them friends.
lore.uncommon: Pops its roof up in the campsite like a startled meerkat, then charges the family for extra headroom.
lore.rare: Can fit an entire household inside its cupboards, except the one frying pan you need.
lore.epic: Unfolded an awning across three motorways and turned an ordinary traffic jam into Europe's largest campsite.
lore.legendary: Nomador rolls through landscapes that have not been discovered yet. Every mile adds another room, and somewhere inside is a bathroom that nobody has found.

names.legendary: Old Mabel, Queen of the Seven Locks

lore.common: Travels so slowly that ducks overtake it, reverse, and overtake it again.
lore.uncommon: Collects canal locks like souvenirs. Insists on taking a nap inside each one.
lore.rare: Carries a cargo of bricks so quietly that the towpath forgets a whole building is passing.
lore.epic: Blocked the city's canal with a single magnificent turn. The traffic report simply read WATER IS CLOSED.
lore.legendary: For centuries Mabel has sailed the inland waterways, carrying forgotten cities in her hold. No lock has ever been too narrow once she tells it to behave.

names.legendary: Skipper Waverend, Lord of Little Seas

lore.common: Thinks every puddle is a respectable marina. Has been asked to leave the birdbath.
lore.uncommon: Keeps stealing the daggerboard, then acts shocked when the boat drifts sideways.
lore.rare: Can capsize on command and reappear upright with everyone's sandwiches safely tucked inside.
lore.epic: Challenged the entire regatta to a race, then stole the wind from every sail. Won by floating backwards while laughing.
lore.legendary: Crossed the Sea of Seven Storms in a boat barely big enough for one sandwich. The ocean offered it a crown; it asked for a bigger bucket.

names.legendary: Ferrymor, Guardian of the Last Crossing

lore.common: Waits until you balance your tea before sounding its foghorn.
lore.uncommon: Swallows a hundred cars and insists it is just having a light snack.
lore.rare: Can cross rough seas without spilling a chip from the onboard café. Passengers remain less composed.
lore.epic: Carried the entire travelling carnival across a stormy bay. The ferris wheel kept spinning, and one very brave seagull bought a ticket.
lore.legendary: Ferrymor has crossed the strait since before the first bridge was built. Every lost traveller finds a place aboard, but the toll is one story worth remembering.

names.legendary: Captain Brinebeard of the First Dawn

lore.common: Has fifty seagulls following it and insists they are paying passengers.
lore.uncommon: Returns to harbour smelling so strongly of fish that the cats gather on the pier.
lore.rare: Can haul up a boot, a bicycle and three lost umbrellas without catching a single fish.
lore.epic: Dragged a net so enormous into the harbour that the catch included a lost rowboat and the mayor's missing garden shed.
lore.legendary: Brinebeard sailed out before the first lighthouse was lit and returned with the stars reflected in its nets. Fishermen still tell the story when the catch is poor.

names.legendary: Venedora, the Bride of the Tides

lore.common: Slides through the canal humming a love song to its own reflection. The gondolier pretends not to hear.
lore.uncommon: Slides so quietly beneath bridges that tourists forget to duck. Their hats rarely survive.
lore.rare: Sings a sweet serenade that makes the canal fish follow in a perfect line.
lore.epic: Guided an entire wedding procession through flooded streets. The guests arrived with dry shoes and damp flowers.
lore.legendary: Venedora ferries the moon's reflection through Venice each night. On rare evenings the moon stays aboard, and the canals glow until dawn.

names.legendary: Lady Driftmere, Keeper of River Homes

lore.common: Rocks everyone to sleep, then bumps the quay loudly at precisely three in the morning.
lore.uncommon: Grows so many roof tomatoes that passing ducks ask whether it's a floating market.
lore.rare: Slips its mooring while everyone sleeps and wakes the family in the next village.
lore.epic: Led an entire flotilla of houseboats through town when the river rose. Residents waved from their kitchen windows as they passed the town hall.
lore.legendary: Driftmere carried the last river village to safety when the great flood came. Its chimney still smokes on moonlit nights, guiding lost travellers home across the water.

names.legendary: Captain Bubblebob of the Seven Seas

lore.common: Squeaks loudly with every paddle stroke, announcing its location to the entire beach.
lore.uncommon: Takes longer to inflate than the family spends on the water.
lore.rare: Springs a tiny leak but stays afloat by swallowing every passing bubble.
lore.epic: Drifted across the bay carrying a duck family and a very indignant picnic basket. The lifeguards saluted it on return.
lore.legendary: Bubblebob crossed a stormy sea on a hull held together by a thousand tiny breaths. The sailors now leave their pumps at the harbour shrine in thanks.

names.legendary: Brightwake, Guardian of the Last Light

lore.common: Hits the slipway at a sprint and gives the pier spectators a free shower.
lore.uncommon: Its orange paint shines through thick fog like a very determined carrot.
lore.rare: Launches into waves that send ordinary boats running back to the harbour.
lore.epic: Rescued every passenger from a stranded ferry on a stormy night, then came back for the captain's forgotten lunchbox.
lore.legendary: Brightwake sailed beyond the reach of the old lighthouse on a night when the stars vanished. Its single orange light guided a whole convoy through the black sea and brought them home before dawn.

names.legendary: Captain Backstroke, Ferryman of Mist

lore.common: Rows in circles until both oars agree on a direction. They rarely do.
lore.uncommon: Creaks in protest every time a passenger says the journey looks easy.
lore.rare: Knows hidden currents that carry stranded ducklings home while the rower believes they are going in the opposite direction.
lore.epic: Challenged the lake's entire rowing club to a race and won while carrying a picnic table, three geese and a sleeping fisherman.
lore.legendary: Captain Backstroke ferries travellers across a mist-covered lake that appears only at dawn. Everyone who returns has grown wiser, except the swan that stole his hat.

names.legendary: Windwarda, Navigator of Lost Seas

lore.common: Leans so far into a breeze that its passengers must rescue the sandwiches.
lore.uncommon: Refuses to sail unless somebody says something nice about the weather.
lore.rare: Finds a hidden current whenever the sails catch a perfect gust. Every motorboat in the bay is furious.
lore.epic: Rode a storm across the harbour, towing an entire parade of stranded fishing boats. The seagulls awarded it a medal made of stolen chips.
lore.legendary: Windwarda sailed beyond the final chart and came back with a map drawn in stars upon her canvas. Nobody can read it until the wind blows from the east.

names.legendary: Admiral Plughole, Master of the Deep

lore.common: Sinks immediately and calls this a tactical surprise.
lore.uncommon: Spies on the rubber duck from behind a fortress of bath bubbles.
lore.rare: Discovers mysterious sunken treasures: two hair clips and a toy dinosaur's missing leg.
lore.epic: Declared the bathtub an independent ocean and surrounded the soap with a fleet of wind-up patrol craft.
lore.legendary: Admiral Plughole mapped the secret ocean beneath every household drain. Its flagship can surface in any bathtub on earth, but insists on announcing itself with bubbles.

names.legendary: Tuggernaut, the Small Giant of the Sea

lore.common: Huffs at every cargo ship for being unnecessarily large.
lore.uncommon: Bumps big vessels gently into place and demands a thank-you toot.
lore.rare: Drags a stranded tanker out of a sandbank while the captain finishes his crossword.
lore.epic: Pulled an entire cruise ship through a hurricane with one stubborn rope and arrived at port in time for the breakfast buffet.
lore.legendary: Tuggernaut once pulled a stranded lighthouse from a crumbling island and carried its light across the bay. Sailors still see his little smokestack whenever a harbour needs saving.

names.legendary: Lady Opulence, Admiral of Unpaid Bills

lore.common: Horns at smaller boats for occupying its favourite patch of sea.
lore.uncommon: Has more polished handrails than actual places to sit.
lore.rare: Makes its own private patch of calm water wherever it anchors, while every nearby boat rocks in protest.
lore.epic: Commodore Goldwake arrived at the regatta with three decks, two pools and an indoor waterfall. A rubber dinghy beat him to the finish line.
lore.legendary: Lady Opulence bought the horizon so no other vessel could enjoy her sunset. Unfortunately, the horizon kept moving away, and her accountants are still chasing it in a smaller boat.

names.legendary: Miss Busalina, Guardian of Schooldays

lore.common: Arrives a minute early on the day everybody oversleeps and waits smugly outside.
lore.uncommon: Stops so gently for a duck family that all the children cheer and the ducks take a bow.
lore.rare: Knows which pupil left their homework at home and turns around just before they remember.
lore.epic: Collected every pupil in the district through a snowstorm and delivered them directly to the classroom windows. The headteacher marked everyone present and very surprised.
lore.legendary: Miss Busalina has carried generations of children safely to their first day of school. Her yellow paint contains one tiny star for every passenger who grew up to follow a dream.

names.legendary: Scootifer, the Wind on Two Wheels

lore.common: Waits until you stop moving, then swings around to clobber your ankle.
lore.uncommon: Folds neatly for the bus and unfolds only when the bus is leaving.
lore.rare: Jumps three kerbs in a row, then brakes to let a snail cross the pavement.
lore.epic: Led every scooter in town on a midnight race around the park. The statues were still cheering when the joggers arrived.
lore.legendary: Scootifer once raced the last sunset from the harbour to the hills, pushing off only once. Morning found its wheels still spinning and the horizon slightly out of breath.

names.legendary: Riksara, Rider of the Thousand Streets

lore.common: Rings its bell at pigeons and occasionally at people.
lore.uncommon: Has a squeaky pedal that tells everyone when the driver is getting tired.
lore.rare: Weaves through a market so smoothly that not one basket of fruit is disturbed.
lore.epic: Delivered an entire wedding party through the narrow old city in one impossible trip. The bride arrived before the invitations.
lore.legendary: Riksara ferried an entire wedding party through alleys so narrow that even the wind had to walk sideways. The bride arrived before the groom's invitation.

names.legendary: Tukkaraja, the King of Impossible Turns

lore.common: Rattles over a pothole and drops a passenger's hat into the next seat.
lore.uncommon: Leans around corners so dramatically that the fruit sellers stop to watch.
lore.rare: Knows narrow alleys that do not appear on maps and reaches any market before the traffic police.
lore.epic: Carried the entire wedding band's instruments through a gridlocked capital while balancing a brass tuba on its roof.
lore.legendary: Tukkaraja won a race against the monsoon through the old city's maze of streets. The rain arrived to find his passengers already drinking tea under a dry awning.

names.legendary: Velocetta of the Endless Path

lore.common: Rolls away the instant you lift your foot, forcing an undignified dance with a railing.
lore.uncommon: Pretends its heel brake has vanished whenever the pavement slopes downhill.
lore.rare: Weaves through a crowded boardwalk without touching a single ice cream cone.
lore.epic: Turned a seaside parade into a high-speed slalom, weaving between stalls, prams and a startled brass band. The band played faster to keep up.
lore.legendary: Velocetta skated the entire coast in one moonlit night, leaving two silver tracks that the tide could not erase. Travellers follow them to find their way home.

names.legendary: Lady Velocetta, Empress of Eight Wheels

lore.common: Has four wheels and absolutely no interest in going where its owner points.
lore.uncommon: Finds the loudest corner of the roller disco and insists on dancing with the snack machine.
lore.rare: Spins so precisely that the chalk circles it draws on the rink become tiny portals to the sweet shop.
lore.epic: Turned a parking garage into a roller disco overnight. The cars are still wearing glitter and refusing to leave.
lore.legendary: Lady Velocetta once skated around a volcano as its lava cooled, leaving a perfect eight-wheeled rink. Even the fire spirits turned up in sequined socks.

names.legendary: Balancia, the Two-Wheeled Oracle

lore.common: Leans forward to greet a stranger and accidentally drives off with their shopping bag.
lore.uncommon: Glides silently through a flock of pigeons, which scatter in perfect formation like offended dancers.
lore.rare: Balances on the edge of a fountain without spilling a single drop from its rider's coffee.
lore.epic: Led an entire city's morning commute in a silent procession on two wheels. The traffic wardens had to invent a new kind of crossing.
lore.legendary: Balancia stood upright through the earthquake that toppled the royal palace. The survivors built a city around her two tyre tracks, and its streets still refuse to tilt.
